description: Interface analysis: every boundary the event build crosses, the pinned published contract on each side (from dependency-lock.json and curation/contracts.json), the operations and failure types the requirements need from it, how compatibility is verified, and known gaps. No adapter or framework is introduced beyond what a documented boundary requires. 'systems' entries must name systems in the dependency lock; 'contracts' entries must name contracts in curation/contracts.json.

interfaces.verification: interface manifest authored at kickoff (T14); producer/consumer contract tests; PAT-03..PAT-08 against the stateful fake and live
interfaces.notes: Confirmations are constructible only inside the persistence module (PERSIST-023); ODR-V4-06 proposes that provider replies also be decoded only there.

operations: paths and file set (manifest.json, events.ndjson, snapshot.json)
interfaces.verification: identities CT-006; golden replay of the five frozen fixtures; negative fixtures refused; INV-11 mutants
interfaces.notes: CONTRACT.md wins over docs/CAUSA-DATA-CONTRACT-v1.md where they differ (CAUSA-STORAGE-RELEASE); Rehearsal 7 built against the candidate first and lost time (D-02).

operations: read the four investigations at a head
full contract validation and replay to the catalog's state digests
interfaces.verification: causa template-verify --template demonstration-v1 (preflight); application load-and-replay of four cases after Connect (UI-015-O2)
interfaces.notes: causa-data's HISTORICAL-CASE-CATALOG.md still says three (finding F-030, resolved by DEC-R7-006).

operations: createCommitOnBranch with expectedHeadOid, fileChanges (additions only under the investigation prefix), message with write-marker trailer
failureTypes: FORBIDDEN 'is at <oid> but expected <oid>' (stale head, observed live in Rehearsal 7)
FORBIDDEN/HTTP 403 with rate-limit or abuse wording (secondary rate limit)
interfaces.verification: T18 live probe of three simultaneous commits and recorded answer forms; PAT-03 live; INV-22
interfaces.notes: GitHub's answer forms are not a published typed contract; the fake must be built from recorded live answers (PF-013), never from assumption.

operations: file read at a named commit (contents API; Git blobs API for files over 1 MB)
compare base...head (paginated beyond 250 commits) for reconciliation
commit read for marker and tree
interfaces.notes: Rehearsal 7 F10/F11: the compare and contents APIs have limits the requirements' 'the commits after the expected head' and 'a re-read' must not silently truncate.

operations: dispatch user events to the F# update loop
apply view projections through data-* bindings
interfaces.verification: AR-029 start smoke on every primary route in a real browser; compatibility smoke in T11
interfaces.notes: Rehearsal 7 KD-007: F# does not run the JSExport source generator, so one small C# [JSExport] host shim is a documented interoperability boundary. KD-010: Limen 0.9.1's protocol has no timer or beforeunload effect, so a small browser-boundary script relays connectivity, timers and the leave warning; it holds no application state. Both are permitted by DEC-003/DEC-030 (smallest isolated adapter) and must be declared in the interface manifest.

failureTypes: missing token (falls back to browser defaults)
interfaces.verification: PAT-15 per state; axe scans; token-existence check of every Forma token the CSS references
interfaces.notes: Rehearsal 7 found after the deadline that four Forma token names in its CSS did not exist, so five properties fell back to system colours; the token-existence check catches this class.

interfaces.boundary: report projection <-> Folio print components (Boundary E)
operations: read-only versioned report projection rendered for print
interfaces.verification: report fidelity and print rendering at the deployed SHA (G8)
interfaces.notes: Folio is not published on npm; it is consumed from its GitHub release tarball with the registry's SHA-256.

interfaces.boundary: rehearsal repository <-> Praxis (requirements preservation, work items)
interfaces.verification: preservation gate PASS before implementation and at acceptance (RDP-004)

operations: semantic contract verification of populated states at the deployed SHA
interfaces.notes: v4 pins the 1.33.0 release (0.3.0); CT-012's identity is the earlier released schema and must be re-checked against 0.3.0 in T11.

interfaces.boundary: rehearsal repository bootstrap and CI policy <-> Conditor
operations: scaffold on the kickoff release set
interfaces.verification: conditor ci-policy check at kickoff and on every candidate
interfaces.notes: Conditor is named by DEC-R7-011 but is not a component of the echelon-current set file; its version is pinned by tag.
